name: aussie.net
summary: Sydney ISP (aussie.net Pty Ltd, ACN 074 677 231) offering transit, virtual-ISP, server-farm, dialup; helped found SNAP (Sydney NAP) and AusBone; defunct.

events.details: Defunct. Both current (c. 2000s) and proposal (c. 2007) are too late: aussie.net itself stated it was no longer an ISP as of the Jul 2000 capture. homepage declared 'aussie.net is not an internet service provider' by Jul 2000; personal pages thereafter.

refs.label: The very next frame after the shell page, captured 6 Jul 2000, explicitly disclaims ISP status — the ISP was already history by mid-2000
Personal placeholder in Apr 2009; domain today serves a 'Go Away' stub
